items.title: 17.5 Solubility of Sulphates and Hydroxides (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 17.5 with Figure 17.4 and Table 17.4, printed pages 7-8.

blocks.text: Kisi ionic compound ki paani mein solubility (ghulne ki salahiyat) do bari energy tabdeeliyon ke tawazun (balance) par munhasir hai:

items: Enthalpy of Hydration (ΔHhyd) woh energy hai jo tab nikalti hai jab gas wale ions ko paani ke molecules gher kar apni taraf kheench lete hain (ion hydrate ho jata hai). Yeh hamesha exothermic hai (qeemat negative). Ion aur paani ki kashish (attraction) jitni mazboot, ΔHhyd utni zyada negative. Chhote ions jin ki charge density zyada ho, paani ko zyada zor se kheenchte hain, is liye in ki hydration enthalpy zyada negative (zyada bari) hoti hai. Group mein neeche ions bare hote hain, is liye ΔHhyd kam negative ho jati hai (kam energy nikalti hai).

Lattice Enthalpy (ΔHlattice) woh energy hai jo ek mole thos ionic compound ko tor kar us ke gas wale ions mein alag karne ke liye chahiye. Yeh hamesha endothermic hai. Crystal lattice (ions ki tarteeb) mein forces jitni mazboot, lattice enthalpy utni zyada. Yeh ions ke charge aur size par munhasir hai. Jab cation aur anion ka size milta julta ho to kashish ki forces mazboot aur lattice energy zyada hoti hai. Jab ek ion bara aur doosra bohat chhota ho to forces kamzor aur lattice energy kam hoti hai.

blocks.text: Enthalpy of solution (ΔHsoln) woh kul energy tabdeeli hai jo thos ionic madda ghulne par hoti hai. ΔHsoln jitni zyada negative (ya kam positive) ho, aam taur par solubility utni zyada hoti hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Ghulne ko do qadam samjhein: pehle lattice ko torna (energy lagti hai = ΔHlattice), phir ions ka paani se ghir jana (energy nikalti hai = ΔHhyd). Agar nikalne wali energy lagne wali energy ke barabar ya zyada ho to compound aasani se ghulta hai.

Group 2 hydroxides ki solubility group mein neeche barhti hai (maslan Mg(OH)₂ bohat kam ghulta hai, Ba(OH)₂ kaafi ghulta hai). Group 2 mein neeche ΔHhyd (M²⁺ ke liye) aur ΔHlattice dono kam hoti hain. Lekin lattice enthalpy ki kami hydration enthalpy ki kami se zyada hoti hai. Chhote Group 2 metal ions wale hydroxides ki lattice energy zyada hoti hai, aur bare ions walon ki kam.
Group 2 sulphates (MSO₄) ki paani mein solubility group mein neeche kam hoti hai (maslan MgSO₄ ghul jata hai aur BaSO₄ nahi ghulta).

blocks.alt: Chart jis mein qataarein Mg, Ca, Sr aur Ba hain. 'Solubility of hydroxides' ke neeche laal teer neeche ki taraf aur bare hote jate hain: oopar 'less soluble', neeche 'more soluble'. 'Solubility of sulphates' ke neeche neele teer oopar ki taraf aur neeche chhote hote jate hain: oopar 'more soluble', neeche 'less soluble'.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.4: Group 2 hydroxides aur sulphates ki hall pazeeri (solubility) ke rujhan (kitab ki Figure 17.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Laal teer batate hain ke hydroxides neeche zyada ghulte hain: Mg(OH)₂ 2 × 10⁻⁵ se Ba(OH)₂ 1.5 × 10⁻² mol/100 g tak. Neele teer batate hain ke sulphates neeche kam ghulte hain: MgSO₄ 1.83 × 10⁻¹ se BaSO₄ 9.43 × 10⁻⁷ tak (Table 17.4). Dono trends ek doosre ke ulat hain.

Sulphate ion (SO₄²⁻) kaafi bara hai. Group 2 mein neeche ΔHhyd (M²⁺ ke liye) aur ΔHlattice dono kam hoti hain. Lekin sulphate jaise bare anion ke liye hydration enthalpy ki kami lattice enthalpy ki kami se zyada hoti hai, is liye ghulna mushkil hota jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Kaun zyada ghulta hai, Sr(OH)₂ ya Mg(OH)₂? Wajah batayein.
blocks.explanation: Sr(OH)₂ (3.4 × 10⁻³ mol/100 g, jab ke Mg(OH)₂ sirf 2 × 10⁻⁵). Hydroxides mein group ke neeche lattice enthalpy hydration enthalpy se zyada tezi se kam hoti hai, is liye neeche wale hydroxides aasani se ghulte hain.

items: Solubility = lattice enthalpy (lagne wali energy) aur hydration enthalpy (nikalne wali energy) ka muqabla.
Hydroxides: neeche zyada ghulte hain (lattice enthalpy zyada kam hoti hai).
Sulphates: neeche kam ghulte hain (bare SO₄²⁻ ki wajah se hydration enthalpy zyada kam hoti hai).
